first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making the inherited onboarding result directly relevant and highly consequential. Promotional pricing is also consequential given competitive pressure, but its effect on sustainable qualified revenue and customer quality needs verification before committing to discounting. I currently intend a guarded onboarding simplification test with downstream checks for qualified activation, retention, and revenue—not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard, instrumented onboarding-shortening experiment this week. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline, with archived evidence of improved completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and a 3% lift in 30-day retention. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it lifted short-term qualified revenue, the 12% retention decline indicates poor sustainable-growth quality. Measure activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention by segment, with guardrails against harming enterprise or higher-value accounts.
